title: Drone as First Responder and Skydio dock program records

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

In January 2026, the Federal Way City Council approved a Drone as First Responder (DFR) program using Skydio Dock for X10 systems. I request the following existing records in the Department's possession, created or modified between January 1, 2025 and the date this request is processed:

1. Contracts, purchase orders, and agreements with Skydio, including costs;
2. Records identifying the locations or siting of drone docks;
3. DFR program policies, procedures, evaluation criteria, and success metrics;
4. Privacy impact assessments or civil-liberties reviews conducted for the program;
5. Flight or deployment logs for DFR missions flown since the program began, sufficient to determine the date, time, general location, and purpose of each deployment.

This request does not seek video or imagery recorded by the drones. I prefer electronic delivery. Please notify me in advance if any copying or production fees will exceed $50.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robin Monks

title: Corti AI call-triage review and assessment records

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: Corti AI call-triage review and assessment records
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The City's Q2 2026 Artificial Intelligence Usage Report (Council SLI ITD-010S-A) states that the Seattle Fire Department is working to ensure that use of Corti AI technology is fully reviewed and that a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) / AI assessment will be posted publicly to reflect all reviews and use cases. I request the following existing records in the Department's possession, created or modified between January 1, 2025 and the date this request is processed, concerning Corti AI technology:

1. The completed or in-progress Privacy Impact Assessment and AI assessment;
2. Review determinations and risk or responsible-AI assessments, including records of reviews conducted with or submitted to the Seattle Information Technology Department;
3. Approval, conditional-approval, denial, pause, or discontinuation decision records;
4. Records identifying the use cases covered by the review.

This request does not seek logs of individual employee prompts or outputs or records concerning specific emergency incidents. I prefer electronic delivery. Please notify me in advance if any copying or production fees will exceed $50.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

title: Seattle Police Department AI software and pilot review records

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: Seattle Police Department AI software and pilot review records
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The City's Q1 2026 Artificial Intelligence Usage Report (Council SLI ITD-010S-A) identifies Seattle Police Department AI software and pilots including CaseGuard, Westlaw Deep research, ForceMetrics, CaseX, Amazon Q, the "C3 Pilot for SPD," and Claude, and the Q2 2026 report lists the "Claude Cowork" pilot (status: building). I request the following existing records in the Department's possession, created or modified between January 1, 2025 and the date this request is processed, for each of those tools:

1. Intake, registration, or review submission records sent to the Seattle Information Technology Department;
2. Review determinations and risk, privacy, responsible-AI, or AI assessments;
3. Approval, conditional-approval, denial, pause, sunset, or discontinuation decision records;
4. Pilot and proof-of-concept evaluation reports, including the completed "C3 Pilot for SPD" evaluation and pilot records for the Corti AI call-triage tool, which the Q1 2026 report states the Department piloted for non-emergency dispatch decisions.

This request does not seek logs of individual employee prompts or outputs, which are covered by other public requests, and does not seek records concerning specific ongoing criminal investigations. I prefer electronic delivery. Please notify me in advance if any copying or production fees will exceed $50.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

title: Microsoft Copilot Chat rollout pause and relaunch records (2025-2026)

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: Microsoft Copilot Chat rollout pause and relaunch records (2025-2026)
communications.communication:

I request existing records in the Department's possession, created or modified between December 1, 2025 and the date this request is processed, concerning the Microsoft Copilot Chat deployment to City employees, including records of the Mayor's Information Technology Subcabinet (MITS) AI Workgroup held by the Department and communications with the Mayor's Office:

title: AI software and pilot review records (Q1/Q2 2026 AI Usage Reports)

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: AI software and pilot review records (Q1/Q2 2026 AI Usage Reports)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Seattle's Artificial Intelligence Policy (POL-211) and 2025-2026 AI Plan require departments to submit AI software and pilots for intake and security, privacy, and responsible-use review before deployment, and Council SLI ITD-010S-A requires quarterly AI usage reports. The Q1 2026 report (April 1, 2026) and Q2 2026 report (July 1, 2026) each contain an Appendix A listing approved AI software and AI pilots.

For each AI software and AI pilot listed in Appendix A of those two reports, I request the following existing records in the Department's possession, created or modified between January 1, 2025 and the date this request is processed:

1. Intake, registration, or software-review submission records;
2. Review determinations and risk, privacy, responsible-AI, or AI assessments;
3. Approval, conditional-approval, denial, pause, discontinuation, or sunset decision records, including the decision records for the Knit.ai pilot pause and the Seattle Public Utilities Drainage & Wastewater pipe data quality pilot;
4. Pilot and proof-of-value evaluation reports submitted to or held by the Department, including the CivCheck proof-of-value evaluation.

This request does not seek logs of individual employee prompts or outputs, which are covered by other public requests. I prefer electronic delivery. Please notify me in advance if any copying or production fees will exceed $50.
